value.text: CI on the PR still fails pm health with history_drift_chain_mismatch/history_drift_hash_mismatch for this item: the tracker carries a tests_update entry written by a 2026.10.13 host, while the repo pinned @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.10.10, which drops per-test updated_by/updated_at fields when hashing. Fix: bump the exact devDependency pin to 2026.10.13 so the pinned host matches the history, without rewriting history. Verified with the pinned host: pm health ok (authority ok) and pm history ops-pack-prepare --verify passes (34 entries, hash chain current_matches_latest true).

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Revert proof: with only the pin reverted (package.json + package-lock.json back to 2026.10.10, node_modules reinstalled to match), the pinned host reproduces the exact CI failure: pm health reports ok:false with history_drift_chain_mismatch:ops-pack-prepare and history_drift_hash_mismatch:ops-pack-prepare, and pm history ops-pack-prepare --verify reports verification ok:false. Restoring the 2026.10.13 pin returns pm health to ok:true (authority ok) and history verification to ok:true. Gates run directly at unchanged thresholds, both exit 0: npm run release:check and bun run release:check (with a clean HOME and no global git config, since the suite exercises git). Note: running the full release:check through the pm test harness fails on one lifecycle-policy non-vacuity test, because the harness reserves/injects PM_PATH for sandbox safety and that test builds a cwd-relative temp tracker; the same gate passes when run directly, matching CI.
